description: This file contains utility functions for encoding and decoding video IDs with provider information, utilizing base64 encoding and supporting aspects like extraction of provider, model ID, and original video ID, specifically tailored for the litellm project.

classes.name: DecodedVideoId
classes.description: A data class representing the decoded components of a video ID, including provider, model ID, and the original video ID.

methods.name: str encode_video_id_with_provider( video_id: str, provider: str, model_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Encodes provider and optionally model ID into a video ID string using base64 encoding.

methods.name: DecodedVideoId decode_video_id_with_provider(encoded_video_id: str)
methods.description: Decodes provider, model ID, and original video ID from an encoded video ID string.

methods.name: str extract_original_video_id(encoded_video_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the original video ID from an encoded video ID, stripping provider information.

ctags.name: encode_video_id_with_provider
ctags.signature: ( video_id: str, provider: str, model_id: Optional[str] = None )
